source.title: Measurement of the Unperturbed Hydrogen Hyperfine Transition Frequency
source.journal: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement IM-19, 200-209 (1970)
source.retrieval: NIST-hosted primary paper via web PDF text; table arithmetic checked; scan not visually verified

scope: Published experimental reduction and observation-map contract; not AOD-generated hydrogen frequency or raw-data reconstruction

preparation.bound: Hyperfine transition and named SAO/NBS-H2 apparatus
preparation.general_mechanism_only: Magnetic state selection, storage bulb in resonant cavity, stimulated microwave emission
preparation.general_source_limit: NIST overview does not reconstruct populations or settings of the 1970 apparatus
device_references_in_paper: SAO: reference 20, Vessot et al., Progress in the development of hydrogen masers (1968)
NP3: reference 21, Peters et al., Atomic hydrogen standards for NASA tracking stations (1969)
NBS-H2: general configuration similar to Varian H-10, p201

reference_chain: NBS-III primary Cs beam; May 1969 calibration
receiver.frequency_scope: Nominal 5 MHz expression requires UTC and NP3 offsets before physical maser frequency is expressed in the Cs-based unit

tuning.condition: Frequency independent of hydrogen beam intensity

Doppler.source: p203 equation4; exponent OCR ambiguous, consistent with TableIV/VI corrections

Zeeman.condition: Low homogeneous field; mean(B)^2 substitutes mean(B^2) within stated uncertainty

experiment_1.tuning_evidence: p204: manual/automatic varactor tuning until beam-flux-independent
experiment_1.wall_evidence: p201: SAO compared to HU reference with independently evaluated wall shift; TableIV +0.0202 Hz

experiment_2.tuning_evidence: p204: two cavity settings by two beam intensities; linear interpolation to beam-flux-independent frequency
experiment_2.wall_evidence: pp206-207: weighted regression against inverse bulb diameter; zero-wall intercept

beat.source: p205 TableIV nu_B; electronic-counter beat-period measurement

UTC_to_atomic_time.source: p205 TableIV delta_UTC; nominal UTC offset

wall.source: p205 TableIV delta_W; p201 HU transfer 20.19 mHz rounded in table

second_order_Doppler.source: p205 TableIV delta_D; measured bulb 320.15 K

Zeeman.source: p205 TableIV delta_Z; measured Zeeman 1020 Hz

zero_wall_corrected_beat.source: p207 TableVI corrected nu_B; p206 TableV regression intercept; delta_N already included

second_order_Doppler.source: p207 TableVI delta_D; mean bulb 297.05 K

Zeeman.source: p207 TableVI delta_Z; mean Zeeman 245 Hz

missing_raw_inputs: Four individual cavity/flux measurements for each tuned beat
Unrounded bulb diameters and fit inputs
comparison_rule: Choose and independently identify apparatus and measurand before evaluating an AOD output; do not choose source or adjust parameters to force its frequency to the published result
